newsitem.title: USA: Enron has agreements with 3 Cajun members.
newsitem.headline: Enron has agreements with 3 Cajun members.

text.p: Enron Capital & Trade Resorces Corp said three of the 12 Cajun Electric Power Cooperative members have signed a memorandum of understanding agreeing Enron will serve as their electricity supplier should it be selected by the bankruptcy court to acquire Cajun's generating assets.
The three members represent nearly 30 percent of the total load of the member cooperatives, selling in excess of 1.8 million megawatt hours of electricity per year, the Enron Corp subsidiary said.
Enron said it has also reached agreement with American Commercial Barge Lines and Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp, two of Cajun Electric Power Cooperative's largest unsecured creditors.

Contingent upon Enron's acquisition of Cajun's assets, both will forgive their unsecured damage claims against Cajun in exchange for long term delivery contracts with Enron, it said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
